utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’m a bit behind on the repair drive updates. Uli can fill me in on the new amount and where it’s going, I think.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep word moving and make sure we’re all on the same plan for the repair drive. Jules is checking in with the others, so we should stay lined up for pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll be there with a few tools for the repair drive. Sam can walk through the repair list with me when he gets here.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll spread the word and check in with folks about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll keep my tools ready and look for Sam when he arrives.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll check in with the others and make sure any donations get over to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, Oren’s got the repair stuff now.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Good, I’ll keep checking in with the others and make sure it stays moving.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Bo’s already on the repair drive, and Vik can keep the list moving so everyone stays on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can keep the repair drive moving and sort the tools with Eli when he brings the list.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Then Vik can keep everyone aligned while I make sure Bo stays on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m keeping an eye out for the rest of the repair drive supplies, and the money is still going into the fund.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, but can you confirm the time? Hana wants that before she heads over.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I don’t have the exact time yet, but I’m checking it now and I’ll let Hana know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing, I’ll swing by later and let Rey know what we got done first at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Dane could help keep this repair drive moving if we need another hand.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, Dane could make a real difference if we need another hand. I’ll keep an ear out and tell Rey what we get done first and what we finish later.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Right, 3:30 after school works for me. I’ll help and remind everyone about the cabinet hinges and the leaky sink under the hall bathroom.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Faye. I’ll walk through the repair list one item at a time and keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll stick with 3:30 after school and keep the list moving.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll bring the list and keep it one item at a time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Who’s on supplies? I want to make sure we don’t stall once the repairs start.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Quinn and Dane are on the review with me, and Sam will walk through the list one item at a time. We can keep supplies tied to that same list so nothing stalls.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, I’ll sort the repair stuff now.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mara's bringing a few tools, and Leo can take a look too. Noah's still behind on it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, I’ll get the repair stuff sorted now.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m waiting to hear what Tess says gets finished first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard Oren’s already there with Noah, and I’m heading over soon too. Leo should be able to inspect the drive when it arrives.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still waiting on Tess to see what gets finished first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, bring it by and I’ll take a look. I’ll show you what’s wrong once I’ve seen it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll line up who’s helping and check the parts tonight. I’ll have a signup ready for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good. When Gus brings it by, I’ll look it over and point out what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you walk me through the repair list?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re starting with Maple and 3rd, and I want the porch and roof checked first. Mara’s bringing the tools, so I’ll make sure the crew stays on that plan.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it, can Sam walk me through the rest of the list too?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m on it. I’ll keep the repair drive moving and sort tools and supplies as we go.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, then I’ll walk through the repair list with Mina one item at a time and keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good. I’ll keep the repair list moving and help sort the tools and supplies as we go.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what time Hana’s planning to head over?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure about Hana’s exact time, but Rosa’s handling the crew and we can keep the repair drive focused there first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, but can you confirm whether Hana’s still aiming for the earlier time?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can Vik keep the repair list moving and keep everyone on the same page?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, Vik can keep folks aligned on the list, and I’ll make sure the donations get to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can Sam walk me through the repair list?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll be there with a few tools for the repair drive. Sam can walk me through the repair list when he gets here.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can take a look once Gus brings it by, and I’ll show you what’s wrong.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I’ll be ready with my tools when it comes by.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m headed over to the repair drive too. If Oren’s already there with Noah, I can catch up once I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Right, but who’s on supplies? I don’t want the repair drive to stall if we’re short-handed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Leo can inspect it once it arrives, and I’ll check what supplies are still needed when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mara said she'd bring a few tools, and Leo can take a look. Noah's still behind on it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oren's sorting it now, and I'm still on the repair drive. Leo can take a look too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What needs fixing on the repair drive, and will it still be done before school pickup?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can check with Hana now and let Kira know what time you’re heading over; Dane can help keep it moving too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That helps, but I still need the specific fix and a clear time estimate before I can say yes to it before pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, 3:30 still works for me after school. I’ll remind everyone about the cabinet hinges and the leaky sink under the hall bathroom.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll keep an eye out for the rest of the supplies and make sure the repair drive money stays in the fund.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Cleo. I’ll make sure everyone knows the supplies are covered and that the money stays in the fund.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll keep an ear out and swing by later to tell Rey what we got done first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Good. I’ll keep Maple and 3rd at the top and make sure the porch and roof are first on the list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it. I’ll pass that along once we see what gets finished first.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Bo’s on the repair drive, and Vik can keep the list moving so everyone stays on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ll sort the repair stuff now, and I’m here with Noah too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can check with Sam and keep the repair list moving too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll line up who’s helping and check the parts tonight, so we can keep the repair drive moving at 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m mostly watching for what gets done first, and Tess can tell us that soon enough.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Tess can call that out, and I’ll still get the parts and help list locked tonight so we know what’s ready for 3:30.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved again from Sunday at the community center to Monday at the school gym.
